policyRequirements: Bind to the verified deployed program and explicit devnet environment before enabling signing
Decode every instruction and verify registry, approved pool, sealed methodology, batch PDA and exact classic SPL vault where present
Require the existing oracle-operator public key as publish runtime signer; allow it to fee-sponsor only these permissionless cranks for approved pool batches
For each crank verify queue cursor, request and position PDA linkage against approved pool state; never accept arbitrary accounts
Allow only reviewed compute-budget unit limits and priority fees; runtime transactions require no heap-frame instruction
Exclude admin, upgrade, token transfer, wallet trade and arbitrary instructions
Preserve signer request-id idempotency and role separation

measurement.note: These local measured values inform a reviewed signer configuration; they do not enable or modify the deployed signing service.
